title: Crew definition (MAT-42)
description: Schema for defining a named collection of agents with shared goals and routing configuration.

name.description: Unique crew identifier (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens)

description.description: Human-readable description of the crew's purpose

shared_goal.description: Goal text injected into each agent's context when dispatched

oneOf.description: Agent name reference (must exist in agents/)

timeout_ms.description: Override default timeout for this agent in this crew

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities this agent must have for task routing

agents.description: Member agents - by name or with per-crew overrides

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump when crew definition shape changes.
